rival_explanations: reputable sponsors have lower agency costs and prioritize their shareholders more

context.industry_setting: SPAC (Special Purpose Acquisition Company) market / de-SPAC business combinations
context.time_period: 2010 to March 2022 (SPACs completing business combinations by March 31, 2022)
context.sample_description: US-listed SPACs that completed their business combinations by March 31, 2022 with complete information for structural estimation; data hand-collected from SEC filings (registration statements, prospectuses, Form 8-Ks, Super 8-Ks), redemptions from the Gritstone SPAC research database, and pricing from CRSP

data_sources.name: Hand-collected SPAC deal database from SEC filings (Form 8-K, Super 8-Ks, prospectuses, sponsor/shareholder agreements)
Center for Research in Security Prices (CRSP)

analyses.label: Reduced-form OLS regression of de-SPAC return on deal terms and sponsor reputation (Eq. 10)

dv.name: de-SPAC return to non-redeeming shareholders (R_sh)
dv.source: Center for Research in Security Prices (CRSP)

key_ivs.name: sponsor compensation / promote shares (theta)
key_ivs.measure: sponsor compensation retained (0.25 is max); promote shares forfeited (number the sponsor offered to forfeit without compensation)
key_ivs.source: Hand-collected SPAC deal database from SEC filings

key_ivs.name: external capital raised (K)
key_ivs.measure: ln(1+K); outside capital raised via unregistered equity sales (e.g., PIPE, FPA) as % of IPO proceeds
key_ivs.source: Hand-collected SPAC deal database from SEC filings

key_ivs.name: offer to target (N^n)
key_ivs.measure: ln(n/N); shares offered to the target as % of total shares of the combined firm
key_ivs.source: Hand-collected SPAC deal database from SEC filings

key_ivs.name: sponsor reputation (D_H)
key_ivs.source: Hand-collected SPAC deal database from SEC filings

analyses.label: Fig. 2: redemption rate vs returns to non-redeeming SPAC shareholders

dv.name: return to non-redeeming shareholders
dv.source: Center for Research in Security Prices (CRSP)

analyses.label: Table 2: Model fit (SMM structural estimation)
analyses.sample: 344 SPACs with complete information for estimation (88% of the 388 that completed business combinations by March 31, 2022)

dv.name: model-implied vs data moments (SMM fit)
dv.measure: mean and standard deviation of external capital ln(1+K), redemption rate delta, sponsor compensation theta, offer to target N^n, and de-SPAC return R_sh; distance minimized via optimal weighting matrix
dv.source: Hand-collected SPAC deal database from SEC filings; Center for Research in Security Prices (CRSP); Gritstone SPAC research database

analyses.label: Table 3: Structural parameter estimates (Simulated Method of Moments)
analyses.sample: 344 SPACs (307 when performance measured with 12-month post de-SPAC returns)

dv.name: estimated structural parameters
dv.measure: 17 parameters: phi1, phi2 (linear/convex cost of external capital); alpha, beta (Beta distribution of sponsor agency cost l); mu_z, sigma_z (log-normal deal quality ln(1+z)); mu_u, sigma_u (log-normal target standalone value ln(u)); b0-b3 (correlation of sponsor reputation with deal fundamentals, Eq. 9); chi (weight on shareholders' private signal, Eq. 10); sigma_e (dispersion of private signals); c0, c1 (level/sensitivity of deal completion rate, Eq. 13); rho (relative bargaining power sponsor vs target, Eq. 14)
dv.source: Hand-collected SPAC deal database from SEC filings; Center for Research in Security Prices (CRSP); Gritstone SPAC research database

analyses.label: Policy analyses / counterfactuals (earnout provisions, disclosure improvements, limits on warrant usage)

dv.name: welfare and distribution of value among sponsors, SPAC shareholders, and target owners
dv.measure: counterfactual model-implied total value created, welfare, and shareholder excess returns under alternative policy regimes
dv.source: Hand-collected SPAC deal database from SEC filings

key_ivs.name: policy interventions
key_ivs.measure: presence of earnout provisions; modest improvements in disclosure; limits on warrant usage
key_ivs.source: Hand-collected SPAC deal database from SEC filings

analyses.label: Appendix B: Robustness — alternative sponsor reputation measures and cash-deliverable effect on deal completion

dv.name: de-SPAC return / deal completion (re-estimated model)
dv.measure: model re-estimated under alternative reputation definitions; effect of cash deliverable on deal completion across target firms
dv.source: Hand-collected SPAC deal database from SEC filings; Center for Research in Security Prices (CRSP)

key_ivs.name: sponsor reputation (performance-based, alternative)
key_ivs.source: Hand-collected SPAC deal database from SEC filings; Center for Research in Security Prices (CRSP)

key_ivs.name: sponsor reputation (background-based, alternative)
key_ivs.source: Hand-collected SPAC deal database from SEC filings

key_ivs.name: cash deliverable
key_ivs.measure: cash consideration (converted to cash-equivalent shares by dividing by price 12 months post de-SPAC); effect on deal completion across different target firms
key_ivs.source: Hand-collected SPAC deal database from SEC filings
